passages.text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.sermon: Levi was a son of Jacob.\r\nLevi had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
passages.sermon: Kohath was a son of Levi.\r\nKohath had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמְרָ֣ם יִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
passages.sermon:
Amram had three children.
Their names were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
Aaron had four sons.
Their names were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י עַמְרָ֔ם אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּמֹשֶׁ֖ה וּמִרְיָ֑םס וּבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן נָדָב֙ וַאֲבִיה֔וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃ס

passages.text: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas, Phinehas was the father of Abishua, Abishua was the father of Bukki, Bukki was the father of Uzzi, Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth, Meraioth was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub, Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz, Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Johanan, Johanan was the father of Azariah, who served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem, Azariah was the father of Amariah, Amariah was the father of Ahitub, Ahitub was the father of Zadok, Zadok was the father of Shallum, Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah, Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was a descendant of Levi.
Eleazar was the father of Phinehas.
Phinehas was the father of Abishua.
Abishua was the father of Bukki.
Bukki was the father of Uzzi.
Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah.
Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth.
Meraioth was the father of Amariah.
Amariah was the father of Ahitub.
Ahitub was the father of Zadok.
Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz.
Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah.
Azariah was the father of Johanan.
Johanan was the father of Azariah.
This Azariah served as priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
Azariah was the father of Amariah.
Amariah was the father of Ahitub.
Ahitub was the father of Zadok.
Zadok was the father of Shallum.
Shallum was the father of Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was the father of Azariah.
Azariah was the father of Seraiah.
Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak.
passages.original: אֶלְעָזָר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ פִּֽינְחָ֔ס פִּֽינְחָ֖ס הֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֲבִישֽׁוּעַ׃ וַאֲבִישׁ֙וּעַ֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ בֻּקִּ֔י וּבֻקִּ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עֻזִּֽי׃ וְעֻזִּי֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ זְרַֽחְיָ֔ה וּֽזְרַֽחְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ מְרָיֽוֹת׃ מְרָיוֹת֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ אֲמַרְיָ֔ה וַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֲחִיטֽוּב׃ וַאֲחִיטוּב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ צָד֔וֹק וְצָד֖וֹק הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֲחִימָֽעַץ׃ וַאֲחִימַ֙עַץ֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ עֲזַרְיָ֔ה וַעֲזַרְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יוֹחָנָֽן׃ וְיוֹחָנָ֖ן הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ עֲזַרְיָ֑ה ה֚וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר כִּהֵ֔ן בַּבַּ֕יִת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּנָ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ וַיּ֥וֹלֶד עֲזַרְיָ֖ה אֶת־ אֲמַרְיָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ אֲחִיטֽוּב׃ וַאֲחִיטוּב֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ צָד֔וֹק וְצָד֖וֹק הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ שַׁלּֽוּם׃ וְשַׁלּוּם֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ חִלְקִיָּ֔ה וְחִלְקִיָּ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ עֲזַרְיָֽה׃ וַעֲזַרְיָה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ שְׂרָיָ֔ה וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־ יְהוֹצָדָֽק׃

passages.text: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
passages.sermon:
Jehozadak was a descendant of Aaron.
Jehozadak went into captivity.
The LORD sent Judah and Jerusalem into exile.
Nebuchadnezzar led this exile.
Jehozadak was taken away at that time.
passages.original: וִיהוֹצָדָ֣ק הָלַ֔ךְ בְּהַגְל֣וֹת יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בְּיַ֖ד נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּֽר׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.sermon: Levi was the father of three sons.\r\nHis sons were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י לֵוִ֑י גֵּרְשֹׁ֕ם קְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

passages.text: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
passages.sermon:
Gershom was a son of Levi.
Gershom had sons.
The sons of Gershom were Libni and Shimei.
Their names were Libni and Shimei.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־ גֵרְשׁ֖וֹם לִבְנִ֥י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
passages.sermon: Kohath was a son of Levi.\r\nKohath had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר וְחֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites listed according to their fathers: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son, Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.
passages.sermon:
Merari was a son of Levi.
Merari had two sons.
Their names were Mahli and Mushi.
These are the families of the Levites.
They are listed by their fathers.
Gershom was also a son of Levi.
Gershom had a son named Libni.
Libni had a son named Jahath.
Jahath had a son named Zimmah.
Zimmah had a son named Joah.
Joah had a son named Iddo.
Iddo had a son named Zerah.
Zerah had a son named Jeatherai.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֣י וּמֻשִׁ֑י וְאֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַלֵּוִ֖י לַאֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ לְֽגֵרְשׁ֑וֹם לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛וֹ יַ֥חַת בְּנ֖וֹ זִמָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ יוֹאָ֤ח בְּנוֹ֙ עִדּ֣וֹ בְנ֔וֹ זֶ֥רַח בְּנ֖וֹ יְאָתְרַ֥י בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son, Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son, Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
passages.sermon:
Kohath was a Levite.
Kohath had a son named Amminadab.
Amminadab had a son named Korah.
Korah had a son named Assir.
Assir had a son named Elkanah.
Elkanah had a son named Ebiasaph.
Ebiasaph had a son named Assir.
Assir had a son named Tahath.
Tahath had a son named Uriel.
Uriel had a son named Uzziah.
Uzziah had a son named Shaul.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י קְהָ֑ת עַמִּינָדָ֣ב בְּנ֔וֹ קֹ֥רַח בְּנ֖וֹ אַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ׃ אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ וְאֶבְיָסָ֥ף בְּנ֖וֹ וְאַסִּ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ׃ תַּ֤חַת בְּנוֹ֙ אוּרִיאֵ֣ל בְּנ֔וֹ עֻזִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ וְשָׁא֥וּל בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The descendants of Elkanah: Amasai, Ahimoth, Elkanah his son, Zophai his son, Nahath his son, Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.
passages.sermon:
Elkanah was a Levite.
Elkanah had two sons.
Their names were Amasai and Ahimoth.
Elkanah had a son named Elkanah.
Elkanah's son was Zophai.
Zophai's son was Nahath.
Nahath's son was Eliab.
Eliab's son was Jeroham.
Jeroham's son was Elkanah.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי֙ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה עֲמָשַׂ֖י וַאֲחִימֽוֹת׃ אֶלְקָנָ֑ה בְּנוֹ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה צוֹפַ֥י בְּנ֖וֹ וְנַ֥חַת בְּנֽוֹ׃ אֱלִיאָ֥ב בְּנ֛וֹ יְרֹחָ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The sons of Samuel: Joel his firstborn and Abijah his second son.
passages.sermon:
Samuel was a prophet and leader in Israel.
Samuel had two sons.
Joel was Samuel’s first son.
Abijah was Samuel’s second son.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֧י שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל הַבְּכֹ֥ר וַשְׁנִ֖י וַאֲבִיָּֽה׃ס

passages.text: The descendants of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son, Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, and Asaiah his son.
passages.sermon:
Merari was an ancestor in Israel.
Merari had a son named Mahli.
Mahli had a son named Libni.
Libni had a son named Shimei.
Shimei had a son named Uzzah.
Uzzah had a son named Shimea.
Shimea had a son named Haggiah.
Haggiah had a son named Asaiah.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֥י מְרָרִ֖י מַחְלִ֑י לִבְנִ֥י בְנ֛וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנ֖וֹ עֻזָּ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ שִׁמְעָ֥א בְנ֛וֹ חַגִּיָּ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ עֲשָׂיָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃פ

passages.text: These are the men David put in charge of the music in the house of the LORD after the ark rested there.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David chose certain men.
David put these men in charge of music.
They led the music in the house of the LORD.
David appointed them after the ark of the covenant came to rest in its place.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶעֱמִ֥יד דָּוִ֛יד עַל־ יְדֵי־ שִׁ֖יר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה מִמְּנ֖וֹחַ הָאָרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: They ministered with song before the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem. And they performed their duties according to the regulations given them.
passages.sermon:
The Levites served as musicians.
They sang before the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was called the Tent of Meeting.
They did this until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.
They followed the regulations for their duties.
They performed their work as they were instructed.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֨וּ מְשָׁרְתִ֜ים לִפְנֵ֨י מִשְׁכַּ֤ן אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵד֙ בַּשִּׁ֔יר עַד־ בְּנ֧וֹת שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וַיַּעַמְד֥וּ כְמִשְׁפָּטָ֖ם עַל־ עֲבוֹדָתָֽם׃

passages.text: These are the men who served, together with their sons. From the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel, the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah, the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai, the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah, the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
passages.sermon:
These are the men who served.
They served together with their sons.
They came from the Kohathite family.
Heman was the singer.
Heman was the son of Joel.
Joel was the son of Samuel.
Samuel was the son of Elkanah.
Elkanah was the son of Jeroham.
Jeroham was the son of Eliel.
Eliel was the son of Toah.
Toah was the son of Zuph.
Zuph was the son of Elkanah.
Elkanah was the son of Mahath.
Mahath was the son of Amasai.
Amasai was the son of Elkanah.
Elkanah was the son of Joel.
Joel was the son of Azariah.
Azariah was the son of Zephaniah.
Zephaniah was the son of Tahath.
Tahath was the son of Assir.
Assir was the son of Ebiasaph.
Ebiasaph was the son of Korah.
Korah was the son of Izhar.
Izhar was the son of Kohath.
Kohath was the son of Levi.
Levi was the son of Israel.
passages.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה הָעֹמְדִ֖ים וּבְנֵיהֶ֑ם מִבְּנֵי֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔י הֵימָן֙ הַמְשׁוֹרֵ֔ר בֶּן־ יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃ בֶּן־ אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֔ם בֶּן־ אֱלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ תּֽוֹחַ׃ בֶּן־ צִיף בֶּן־ אֶלְקָנָ֔ה בֶּן־ מַ֖חַת בֶּן־ עֲמָשָֽׂי׃ בֶּן־ אֶלְקָנָה֙ בֶּן־ יוֹאֵ֔ל בֶּן־ עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ צְפַנְיָֽה׃ בֶּן־ תַּ֙חַת֙ בֶּן־ אַסִּ֔יר בֶּן־ אֶבְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ קֹֽרַח׃ בֶּן־ יִצְהָ֣ר בֶּן־ קְהָ֔ת בֶּן־ לֵוִ֖י בֶּן־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Heman’s kinsman was Asaph, who served at his right hand: Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea, the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah, the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei, the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
passages.sermon:
Asaph was Heman’s kinsman.
Asaph served at Heman’s right hand.
Asaph was the son of Berechiah.
Berechiah was the son of Shimea.
Shimea was the son of Michael.
Michael was the son of Baaseiah.
Baaseiah was the son of Malchijah.
Malchijah was the son of Ethni.
Ethni was the son of Zerah.
Zerah was the son of Adaiah.
Adaiah was the son of Ethan.
Ethan was the son of Zimmah.
Zimmah was the son of Shimei.
Shimei was the son of Jahath.
Jahath was the son of Gershom.
Gershom was the son of Levi.
passages.original: וְאָחִ֣יו אָסָ֔ף הָעֹמֵ֖ד עַל־ יְמִינ֑וֹ אָסָ֥ף בֶּן־ בֶּרֶכְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ שִׁמְעָֽא׃ בֶּן־ מִיכָאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ בַּעֲשֵׂיָ֖ה בֶּן־ מַלְכִּיָּֽה׃ בֶּן־ אֶתְנִ֥י בֶן־ זֶ֖רַח בֶּן־ עֲדָיָֽה׃ בֶּן־ אֵיתָ֥ן בֶּן־ זִמָּ֖ה בֶּן־ שִׁמְעִֽי׃ בֶּן־ יַ֥חַת בֶּן־ גֵּרְשֹׁ֖ם בֶּן־ לֵוִֽי׃ס

passages.text: On the left were their kinsmen, the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer, the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Merari stood on the left side.
They were kinsmen of the Levites.
Ethan was among them.
Ethan was the son of Kishi.
Kishi was the son of Abdi.
Abdi was the son of Malluch.
Malluch was the son of Hashabiah.
Hashabiah was the son of Amaziah.
Amaziah was the son of Hilkiah.
Hilkiah was the son of Amzi.
Amzi was the son of Bani.
Bani was the son of Shemer.
Shemer was the son of Mahli.
Mahli was the son of Mushi.
Mushi was the son of Merari.
Merari was the son of Levi.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם עַֽל־ הַשְּׂמֹ֑אול אֵיתָן֙ בֶּן־ קִישִׁ֔י בֶּן־ עַבְדִּ֖י בֶּן־ מַלּֽוּךְ׃ בֶּן־ חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־ אֲמַצְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חִלְקִיָּֽה׃ בֶּן־ אַמְצִ֥י בֶן־ בָּנִ֖י בֶּן־ שָֽׁמֶר׃ בֶּן־ מַחְלִי֙ בֶּן־ מוּשִׁ֔י בֶּן־ מְרָרִ֖י בֶּן־ לֵוִֽי׃ס

passages.text: Their fellow Levites were assigned to every kind of service of the tabernacle, the house of God.
passages.sermon:
The Levites were a tribe in Israel.
The Levites served God.
The Levites worked in the tabernacle.
The tabernacle was the house of God.
The Levites’ fellow Levites received assignments.
They did every kind of service in the tabernacle.
They worked in all the duties of the house of God.
passages.original: וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַלְוִיִּ֑ם נְתוּנִ֕ים לְכָ֨ל־ עֲבוֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: But Aaron and his sons did all the work of the Most Holy Place. They presented the offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
His sons served as priests with him.
Aaron and his sons worked in the Most Holy Place.
They offered sacrifices on the altar of burnt offering.
They burned incense on the altar of incense.
They did every holy task in the sanctuary.
They made atonement for Israel.
They did everything Moses, the servant of God, commanded.
passages.original: וְֽאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו מַקְטִירִ֨ים עַל־ מִזְבַּ֤ח הָֽעוֹלָה֙ וְעַל־ מִזְבַּ֣ח הַקְּטֹ֔רֶת לְכֹ֕ל מְלֶ֖אכֶת קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּלְכַפֵּר֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֔ה מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ

passages.text: These were the descendants of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son, Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son, Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son, Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
Aaron had descendants.
Aaron’s son was Eleazar.
Eleazar’s son was Phinehas.
Phinehas’s son was Abishua.
Abishua’s son was Bukki.
Bukki’s son was Uzzi.
Uzzi’s son was Zerahiah.
Zerahiah’s son was Meraioth.
Meraioth’s son was Amariah.
Amariah’s son was Ahitub.
Ahitub’s son was Zadok.
Zadok’s son was Ahimaaz.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֛וֹ פִּֽינְחָ֥ס בְּנ֖וֹ אֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ בְּנֽוֹ׃ בֻּקִּ֥י בְנ֛וֹ עֻזִּ֥י בְנ֖וֹ זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃ מְרָי֥וֹת בְּנ֛וֹ אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אֲחִיט֥וּב בְּנֽוֹ׃ צָד֥וֹק בְּנ֖וֹ אֲחִימַ֥עַץ בְּנֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: Now these were the territories assigned to the descendants of Aaron from the Kohathite clan for their settlements, because the first lot fell to them: They were given Hebron in the land of Judah and its surrounding pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Aaron belonged to the Kohathite clan.
They received their settlements by lot.
The first lot fell to them.
They received territories for their homes.
They were given Hebron.
Hebron is in the land of Judah.
They also received the pasturelands around Hebron.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מוֹשְׁבוֹתָ֔ם לְטִירוֹתָ֖ם בִּגְבוּלָ֑ם לִבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ לְמִשְׁפַּחַ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֔י כִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם הָיָ֥ה הַגּוֹרָֽל׃ וַֽיִּתְּנ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם אֶת־ חֶבְר֖וֹן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: But the fields and villages around the city were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
passages.sermon: Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.\r\nPeople gave Caleb the fields around the city.\r\nPeople also gave Caleb the villages around the city.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ שְׂדֵ֥ה הָעִ֖יר וְאֶת־ חֲצֵרֶ֑יהָ נָתְנ֖וּ לְכָלֵ֥ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּֽה׃ס

passages.text: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The descendants of Aaron belonged to the Kohathite clan of Levites.
The Israelites gave cities to the descendants of Aaron.
These cities included cities of refuge.
They gave them Hebron.
They gave them Libnah.
They gave them Jattir.
They gave them Eshtemoa.
They gave them Hilen.
They gave them Debir.
They gave them Ashan.
They gave them Juttah.
They gave them Beth-shemesh.
They gave them the pasturelands around each city.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן נָתְנוּ֙ אֶת־ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֶת־ חֶבְר֥וֹן וְאֶת־ לִבְנָ֖ה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ יַתִּ֥ר וְאֶֽת־ אֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ חִילֵז֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ אֶת־ דְּבִ֖יר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ עָשָׁן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

passages.text: And from the tribe of Benjamin they were given Gibeon, Geba, Alemeth, and Anathoth, together with their pasturelands. So they had thirteen cities in all among their families.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin gave cities to the priests.
They gave Gibeon and its pasturelands.
They gave Geba and its pasturelands.
They gave Alemeth and its pasturelands.
They gave Anathoth and its pasturelands.
In total, the priests received thirteen cities from the families of Benjamin.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֗ן אֶת־ גֶּ֤בַע וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֙יהָ֙ וְאֶת־ עָלֶ֣מֶת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ עֲנָת֖וֹת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ כָּל־ עָרֵיהֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: To the rest of the Kohathites, ten cities were allotted from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were a group of Levites.
Some Kohathites remained after others received their cities.
These remaining Kohathites belonged to their own families.
They received cities by casting lots.
They received ten cities in total.
These ten cities came from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י קְהָ֜ת הַנּוֹתָרִ֗ים מִמִּשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמַּטֶּ֡ה מִֽ֠מַּחֲצִית מַטֵּ֨ה חֲצִ֧י מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה בַּגּוֹרָ֖ל עָרִ֥ים עָֽשֶׂר׃ס

passages.text: The Gershomites , according to their clans, were allotted thirteen cities from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.
passages.sermon:
The Gershomites belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The Gershomites had different clans.
The Gershomites received cities as their inheritance.
The Gershomites received thirteen cities in total.
The Gershomites received these cities from four tribes.
The first tribe was Issachar.
The second tribe was Asher.
The third tribe was Naphtali.
The fourth tribe was Manasseh.
The cities from Manasseh were in the region of Bashan.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֨י גֵרְשׁ֜וֹם לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִ֠שָׂשכָר וּמִמַּטֵּ֨ה אָשֵׁ֜ר וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה מְנַשֶּׁה֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן עָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃ס

passages.text: The Merarites, according to their families, were allotted twelve cities from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
passages.sermon:
The Merarites were a group of Levites.
The Merarites had families.
The Merarites received cities by lot.
The Merarites received twelve cities.
The Merarites received these cities from the tribe of Reuben.
The Merarites received these cities from the tribe of Gad.
The Merarites received these cities from the tribe of Zebulun.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֨י מְרָרִ֜י לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֗ם מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְ֠אוּבֵן וּֽמִמַּטֵּה־ גָ֞ד וּמִמַּטֵּ֤ה זְבוּלֻן֙ בַּגּוֹרָ֔ל עָרִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה׃

passages.text: So the Israelites gave to the Levites these cities and their pasturelands.
passages.sermon: The Israelites gave cities to the Levites.\r\nThe Israelites also gave pasturelands to the Levites.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֖ים וְאֶת־ מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They assigned by lot the cities named above from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites assigned cities by casting lots.
They chose cities from the tribe of Judah.
They chose cities from the tribe of Simeon.
They chose cities from the tribe of Benjamin.
They assigned these cities by their names.
passages.original: וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ בַגּוֹרָ֗ל מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בְנֵי־ יְהוּדָה֙ וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי־ שִׁמְע֔וֹן וּמִמַּטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֵ֚ת הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־ יִקְרְא֥וּ אֶתְהֶ֖ם בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: And some of the clans of the Kohathites were given cities from the tribe of Ephraim for their territory: They were given Shechem (a city of refuge) with its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, and Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-horon, Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were a group among the Levites.
Some families of the Kohathites received cities as their territory.
These cities came from the tribe of Ephraim.
The Kohathites received Shechem.
Shechem was a city of refuge.
Shechem was in the hill country of Ephraim.
They also received the pasturelands around Shechem.
They received Gezer.
They received the pasturelands around Gezer.
They received Jokmeam.
They received the pasturelands around Jokmeam.
They received Beth-horon.
They received the pasturelands around Beth-horon.
They received Aijalon.
They received the pasturelands around Aijalon.
They received Gath-rimmon.
They received the pasturelands around Gath-rimmon.
passages.original: וּמִֽמִּשְׁפְּח֖וֹת בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֑ת וַיְהִי֙ עָרֵ֣י גְבוּלָ֔ם מִמַּטֵּ֖ה אֶפְרָֽיִם׃ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־ עָרֵ֧י הַמִּקְלָ֛ט אֶת־ שְׁכֶ֥ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֖יהָ בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וְאֶת־ גֶּ֖זֶר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶֽת־ יָקְמְעָם֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית חוֹר֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ אַיָּלוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ גַּת־ רִמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃פ

passages.text: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh the remaining clans of the Kohathites were given Aner and Bileam, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Kohathites were a group of Levites.
Some Kohathite clans still needed land.
The leaders gave land to these remaining Kohathite clans.
They took land from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
They gave the city of Aner to the Kohathites.
They also gave Aner’s pasturelands to them.
They gave the city of Bileam to the Kohathites.
They also gave Bileam’s pasturelands to them.
passages.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִית֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־ עָנֵר֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ בִּלְעָ֖ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ לְמִשְׁפַּ֥חַת לִבְנֵי־ קְהָ֖ת הַנּוֹתָרִֽים׃פ

passages.text: The Gershomites received the following: From the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh they were given Golan in Bashan and also Ashtaroth, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Gershomites were a group of Levites.
The Gershomites belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The Gershomites received cities as their inheritance.
The half-tribe of Manasseh gave cities to the Gershomites.
The Gershomites received Golan in Bashan.
Golan included its pasturelands.
The Gershomites also received Ashtaroth.
Ashtaroth included its pasturelands.
passages.original: לִבְנֵי֮ גֵּרְשׁוֹם֒ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֗חַת חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה אֶת־ גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ עַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

passages.text: From the tribe of Issachar they were given Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Levites received cities from the tribe of Issachar.
The tribe of Issachar gave them Kedesh.
Kedesh included its pasturelands.
They also gave them Daberath.
Daberath included its pasturelands.
They gave them Ramoth.
Ramoth included its pasturelands.
They gave them Anem.
Anem included its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה יִשָׂשכָ֔ר אֶת־ קֶ֖דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־ דָּבְרַ֖ת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ רָאמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ עָנֵ֖ם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

passages.text: From the tribe of Asher they were given Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Gershomites were Levites.
They received towns from the tribe of Asher.
They received Mashal and its pasturelands.
They received Abdon and its pasturelands.
They received Hukok and its pasturelands.
They received Rehob and its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר אֶת־ מָשָׁ֖ל וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ עַבְדּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ חוּקֹק֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ רְחֹ֖ב וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

passages.text: And from the tribe of Naphtali they were given Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Naphtali gave three towns and their pasturelands.
They gave Kedesh in Galilee and its pasturelands.
They gave Hammon and its pasturelands.
They gave Kiriathaim and its pasturelands.
passages.original: וּמִמַּטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֗י אֶת־ קֶ֤דֶשׁ בַּגָּלִיל֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ חַמּ֖וֹן וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ קִרְיָתַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס

passages.text: The Merarites (the rest of the Levites) received the following: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Rimmono and Tabor, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Merarites were Levites.
The Merarites were the remaining Levites who had not yet received land.
The Merarites received land from the tribe of Zebulun.
The Merarites received the town of Rimmono.
The Merarites received the pasturelands around Rimmono.
The Merarites also received the town of Tabor.
The Merarites received the pasturelands around Tabor.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֮ הַנּוֹתָרִים֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֶת־ רִמּוֹנ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ אֶת־ תָּב֖וֹר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

passages.text: From the tribe of Reuben east of the Jordan opposite Jericho they were given Bezer in the wilderness, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Reuben lived east of the Jordan River.
This land was opposite Jericho.
The Levites received cities from the tribe of Reuben.
They received Bezer in the wilderness.
They received the pasturelands around Bezer.
They received Jahzah.
They received the pasturelands around Jahzah.
They received Kedemoth.
They received the pasturelands around Kedemoth.
They received Mephaath.
They received the pasturelands around Mephaath.
passages.original: וּמֵעֵ֜בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֣ן יְרֵחוֹ֮ לְמִזְרַ֣ח הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ מִמַּטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶת־ בֶּ֥צֶר בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ יַ֖הְצָה וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ קְדֵמוֹת֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ מֵיפַ֖עַת וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃

passages.text: And from the tribe of Gad they were given Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, together with their pasturelands.
passages.sermon:
The Merarites were Levites.
They received cities from the tribe of Gad.
They received Ramoth in Gilead.
They received the pasturelands of Ramoth.
They received Mahanaim.
They received the pasturelands of Mahanaim.
They received Heshbon.
They received the pasturelands of Heshbon.
They received Jazer.
They received the pasturelands of Jazer.
passages.original: וּמִ֨מַּטֵּה־ גָ֔ד אֶת־ רָאמ֥וֹת בַּגִּלְעָ֖ד וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֑יהָ וְאֶֽת־ מַחֲנַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ וְאֶת־ חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶׁ֔יהָ וְאֶת־ יַעְזֵ֖יר וְאֶת־ מִגְרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃ס
